lead: Each series progresses with age-appropriate materials, play, repetition, and digital support.

steps.desc: Basic, Junior, Senior, or PRO is selected according to age, classroom structure, and learning goals.

steps.title: Continue digitally
steps.desc: The library, digital content, and academy flow carry learning into after-school processes.
